# Generated DoubleDeal Lean

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are produced from
[`primitives/cipher/doubledeal/doubledeal.sudo`](../../../../primitives/cipher/doubledeal/doubledeal.sudo)
by `proofs/emit_lean.sh`.

This directory is a standalone Lake package (its own `lakefile.lean`).
It is **not** imported by the proof-only `DoubleDeal` library next door.
`lake-manifest.json` is committed (same as `proofs/doubledeal/lean/`) so
`lean-action` can `lake build`; do not gitignore it.

See [`proofs/ANTI_DRIFT.md`](../../../ANTI_DRIFT.md).
